diffusion model: A network that makes a picture by starting from pure noise and removing a little of it at a time. The idea behind the AI image generators that appeared in 2022.
noise: Randomness with no pattern in it, like the static on an old TV tuned to no channel.
noise level: How much noise has been mixed into a picture. In this book's demo, level 0 is the clean picture and level 50 is almost nothing but noise.
conditioning: Giving a network extra information, such as a label or a text prompt, to steer what it makes.
prompt: What you give a generative model to tell it what you want: a question for a chatbot, a description for an image generator.
latent: A compressed version of a picture: a much smaller grid of numbers that a network can turn back into pixels.
